verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs say designers can prototype interactions by connecting boards that act as screens, and it advertises interactive prototypes. A community user reports the prototype feature works well. The specific elements the story names are not documented in the evidence. missing for 10: documented trigger types (click/hover/etc.), documented transition/animation options, documented overlay support, hands-on corroboration of those specifics.

support.subject: As a designer, I can wire screens into clickable prototypes with triggers, transitions, and overlays — no code required

citations.quote: Penpot allows you to prototype interactions by connecting boards, which can act as screens.
Design responsive and rules-based interfaces with wireframes, interactive prototypes, and CSS Grid and Flex layouts.
The prototype feature is working great as well.
